merchant/30147.htm.text: Merchant Unoren: Welcome, friend! Here you can buy top-notch weaponry to guarantee victory in battle. We carry everything from sharp-bladed Bronze Daggers to the highest-quality Mithril Swords. Take a look around and let me know what you'd like.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30147-pk.htm.text: Trader Unoren: I will not trade with you, foreign traveler with bloodshot eyes. Leave this place at once.
